description: Repeating an input of NAND or NOR expresses its negation; NAND of the repeated-input negations expresses disjunction, and NOR of them expresses conjunction.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.single_gate_identities.{u} {α : Type u}
  (k : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.GateKind) (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α)
  (A B : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.SingleGateFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gateEval k v (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gateNeg A) =
      !Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gateEval k v A ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gateEval k v
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gateConj k A B) =
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gateEval k v A &&
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gateEval k v B) ∧
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gateEval k v
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gateDisj k A B) =
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gateEval k v A ||
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gateEval k v B)
